title: ASG Content OS v2 — Article Dossier
description: The master object that accumulates as one article flows through the 28-step pipeline. Each skill writes its own section; later skills read earlier sections. Stored at data/runs/<article_id>/dossier.json. n8n note: this is the merged item that flows between nodes; each node sets its own section and passes the whole dossier on.

topic.description: Raw topic as Janson proposed it.

article_type.description: Set by asg-strategic-filter. null until Filter runs. Drives word count, H2 count, link counts, density across all downstream skills.

language.description: Language discipline. Set at Filter/Keyword stage by target market.

cluster.description: Topical cluster this article belongs to or extends, e.g. UK Cluster.

draft.description: Written by asg-seo-writer-v2: html, rank_math_settings, asset_manifest, h2_blocks with library_refs.

publish_package.description: Step 23 packaging output (meta variants, slug, schema blocks).

library_refs.description: Union of all Library IDs referenced anywhere in this dossier. Editorial Gate cross-checks.

history.description: Append-only log of which skill touched the dossier when, for traceability.
